children: The Board of UIL Limited has declared a fourth quarterly interim dividend of 2.00p per ordinary share in respect of the year ended 30 June 2026, which will be paid on 30 September 2026 to shareholders on the register on 11 September 2026. The ordinary shares will go ex-dividend on 10 September 2026.
